program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (build-grid 3
                       3
                       (or oc)
                       (let ((rs (if (zero? or)
                                     (list 0)
                                     (if (= or 2) (list (- h 1)) (range 1 (- h 1)))))
                             (cs (if (zero? oc)
                                     (list 0)
                                     (if (= oc 2) (list (- w 1)) (range 1 (- w 1))))))
                         (reduce (lambda (acc r)
                                   (reduce (lambda (a c)
                                             (let ((v (at g r c))) (if (!= v 0) v a)))
                                           acc
                                           cs))
                                 0
                                 rs))))))
